sayWindow: 🪨 A person, maybe 30s, with calloused knuckles pries 1 stone loose from the creek bed. The building pile grows. (2 stone now.)
🪵 Gilberto hauls back 6 wood. The pile grows. (28 logs now.)
Urpi stopped asking. They just started organizing the Gather deadfall crews. Nobody stopped them.
💧 Urpi returns with water: +2 clean.
💧 Quinn returns with water: +4 clean.
🚶 Boris is back — found Quinn.
🧳 A traveler passed through yesterday, talking about a village to the east called Stonebridge. The region is bigger than your fire.
Rain. Steady, cold, honest rain.
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. The spiral has started.
Village meal: +1200 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry. (Half ration — they don't trust you yet.)
Sigrun and Consuelo are comparing scars like trading cards.
Fireside lesson: Aknur passes around a towering fan palm, black and straight as a pillar. Someone asks a dumb question. Nobody minds. That's how you learn.

Urpi spends the afternoon with the upright fuzzy red berry cones, compound leaves, velvety new branches — look, smell, the smallest taste, then waiting. An hour passes. Then another. Nothing. The fire nods. That's dinner, maybe.
From the lumped bag: Staghorn Sumac — named, and out.
★ IDENTIFIED: Staghorn Sumac. Fuzzy red berry cones pointing up like torches. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
💡 Staghorn Sumac. The upright fuzzy red berry cones, compound leaves, velvety new branches you've been looking at for days finally has a name, and now you'll never unsee it.
Aknur was watching. Now they know Staghorn Sumac too.
Quinn is hurt — a fall, a thorn, a bad step. (health 83/100)
Sigrun traded something with someone for something else. The barter economy stirs.
🤢 Sam's stomach knots — something in their meal was off.
Quinn and Urpi lingered over the fire together.
Boris and Quinn lingered over the fire together.
🍽️ Sigrun carries the day's surplus to the pantry door, thinks better of it, and turns back to the fire. "It'll only rot in there. We eat."
💧 The cistern won't cover today — the hall's call, no vote needed: half rations until the water runs come back.
Aknur sits with Sam — cool cloth, bitter tea, watching the breathing.
— DAY 6 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
Overnight, 2 unknown berries went bad — beyond saving. You leave it for the flies.
Fresh food keeps days, not weeks. Smoke it over a fire to make it last.
The fire burns low. 2 new lines in the journal tonight — loudest: Common Plantain — named and noted.
Gilberto Strong reads the sky: clear tomorrow, cold.
MOLT: your skin splits. You step out new, whole — and naked. All equipped gear lost in the old skin. (Once per week.)
📓 Journal: you UNDERSTAND Molt. It resonates with: something unnamed.
(−100 kcal — food becomes molt.)
